messages:
zoe: noticed NVMe IO drop + temp climb on several eu-south2 flashpack-2 nodes, attach queue climbing for gpu pods. dash https://dash.redwood.internal/q/evict-eus2 :warning:
ops-bot: ALERT nvme_temp_high cluster=eu-south2 nodes=27 peak_temp=83C iops_drop=32%
kevin: these nodes had the 1.3.7 firmware pushed last night. logs show `nvme0 timeout` spikes and increased ecc counts on nvme0n1.
marta: ops says row3 rack got an HVAC pressure blip at ~02:12 UTC. might be combined effect. suggest enabling high-fan-profile on affected PDUs and throttling background scrub.
zoe: agree. plan: 1) set fan-profile, 2) cordon 8 most-impacted nodes, drain preemptibles first, 3) pause janitor on cordoned nodes, 4) collect SMART and dmesg and open vendor ticket.
kevin: running cordon script now: `./infra/cordon.sh --nodes list_eus2_hot.txt --batch 4`
ops-bot: OP-5491 created for AC on-site; ETA ~35m
marta: cost note: if we spin up temporary capacity in eu-west1 it's ~$2.8k/day for the size needed. approve for SLO protection?
zoe: approve for customer-facing pools. keep Dedicated customers on priority.
kevin: nvme smart logs collected for sample node gnode-eus2-45: `ecc_err=9 temp=82C retries=3` uploading to incident INC-2026-349.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-349 assigned to infra-oncall.
marta: if vendor confirms firmware interaction we need rollback playbook ready. I'll draft a short comms template.
